decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development by virtue of the size of the building, the inadequate parking facilities and amenity space would constitute overdevelopment of the site to the detriment of the area. The porposal is therefore contrary to Policies ENV.1.1., H.1.2 and  H.3.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and ENV.B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Unitary Development Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development by virtue of its mass, height, location and design would have an adverse effect on the character and appearance of the Conservation Area and general streetscene, contrary to Policies ENV.1.1 and ENV.1.2 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1 and ENV.B.2.2 of the Unitary Development Plan Revised Deposit 2001.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development by virtue of its size, mass and location would have an unacceptable impact on the amenity of adjacent residential properties in terms of loss of light, outlook and overbearing impact, contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, H.1.2 and H.3.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 1996 and Policies ENV.B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.3 of the Unitary Development Plan 2001.
